passive.name: Void Stone
passive.description: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

primaryAbilities.name: Null Sphere
primaryAbilities.description: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and interrupting channels. Kassadin also gains <shield>{{ totalshield }} Magic Shield</shield> for 1.5 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Nether Blade
primaryAbilities.description: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Kassadin's Attacks deal an additional {{ onhitdamage }} magic damage.

Active: Kassadin charges his blade, causing his next Attack to deal {{ activedamage }} magic damage and restore {{ missingmanaratio }}% missing Mana, increased to {{ championmissingmanaratio }}% against champions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Force Pulse
primaryAbilities.description: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Force Pulse's Cooldown is reduced by {{ reductionperspellcast }} second whenever any Ability is used near Kassadin.

Active: Kassadin unleashes a void pulse, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and Slowing by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Riftwalk
primaryAbilities.description: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location, dealing {{ basedamage }} magic damage.

Each subsequent use of this Ability within the next {{ rstackduration }} seconds doubles the Mana cost and deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} magic damage. The cost and damage increases can stack up to {{ maxstacks }} times.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
